entities.summary: The first multi-ethnic empire in recorded history (c. 2334-2154 BCE), founded by Sargon of Akkad in Mesopotamia. Stretching from the Mediterranean to the Persian Gulf, the Akkadian Empire unified Sumerian and Semitic peoples under a single administration, establishing imperial governance practices that influenced all subsequent Near Eastern empires.
